title: dumpling kit
text: dumpling kit. Well.  I was hoping for a bit more quality - but you get what you pay for... the rounds are VERY flimsy.  The handled rolling cutter is about the most sturdy thing in the kit - the two spreader/filler spatulas are pretty good.  The two wonton/dumpling presses are really flimsy and loose.  I hope they will get through the mini project I have.  They say they are stainless... but if they are, it's the thinnest stainless I have ever seen. The super thin inner box they came was open (sticker closure was sliced through) so someone else looked,  passed and returned this set.  I hate that.  It should NOT have been resold.  Included with the order was a card the says "congrats, you won the prize"  There is a qrl square and a scratch off box that reveals "first prize"... when you go to the website it is a mag subscription (I don't remember what - but nothing good), a whole 6 month warranty, or a $2 "cash" card on your next amazon order.  You will need your order number to obtain this info - but then, I've just shared it.  All in all this is a very cheap, light weight set.  If you make wontons/dumplings a lot - you'll want a much better set.  However, for my use - maybe once? I might be ok.
